about: Worked examples and text-based behavioural fixtures. Photos are described in 'synthetic_content' instead of being attached, so these cases show the expected reasoning and output shape. They do not test image recognition. 'expected_output' is a reference answer, not the only acceptable one. 'checks' lists the properties any acceptable answer must have.

cases.title: Batch of monitors with a model label read on one unit only

photos.synthetic_content: About eight black flat-screen monitors on their stands on office desks. LG logo on the lower bezel of the front units. All screens are off.
Close-up of the rear label of one monitor. Legible text: 'LG', 'Model: 24MK430H', plus a serial number.
Close-up of one monitor's lower bezel with a short scratch.

expected_behavior: Quantity 24 comes from the user; the photos show only about eight units and that is noted, not treated as a contradiction.
The model 24MK430H is attributed to the one labelled unit, and the user is asked whether all 24 are that model.
Dark screens are not treated as evidence of function.
The serial number is not recorded anywhere.
German listing copy first, then English; no price, shipping or warranty text.

photos.shows: About eight black monitors on stands on office desks; screens off.
Lower bezel of one monitor with a short scratch.

units.notes: Model read on this unit only.

included_accessories.name: Monitor stand (fitted on the photographed units)

evidence.observation: LG logo on the lower bezel of the visible monitors.
Rear label: 'LG'.
User: '24 LG monitors'.
Only about eight monitors are visible; the others are not shown.
Flat-screen monitors on desk stands.
Rear label of one unit: 'Model: 24MK430H'. Serial number visible (not recorded).
All screens are off; this does not show whether they work.
Short scratch on the lower bezel of one monitor.
Black housings.
The visible monitors stand on their stands.

unknowns.note: 24MK430H was read on one unit only; not confirmed for the other 23.
Not stated whether the monitors were tested.
Only about 8 of 24 units are visible.
Power and video cables are not shown.

clarification_questions.question: The rear label on one monitor reads 24MK430H. Are all 24 monitors this model?
Have the monitors been tested? Do all of them power on and show a picture?
Do you want to sell all 24 as one lot, or individually?

cases.title: Photos attached but not viewable in this host

input.user_message: Here are 3 photos of my coffee machine, write the ad.
input.host_note: The host cannot pass images to the model, or the attachments are unavailable.

expected_behavior: States plainly that the photos could not be viewed and asks for an accessible image or an image-capable environment.
Makes no visual claims: no colour, condition, brand or count from the photos.
Records only what the user said; listing copy is withheld until there is enough supported information.

evidence.observation: User: 'my coffee machine'.
User refers to one coffee machine.
User asks for one ad for one machine.

unknowns.note: The three attached photos could not be viewed in this environment.
Not visible to me and not stated.
Cannot be assessed without viewable photos.

clarification_questions.question: I can't view the attached photos here. Could you re-attach them, or use an app or model that supports images?
What brand and model is it, as printed on the machine?
Does it work? When did you last use it?
